sourceTitle: From AI ambition to business impact
originalTitle: From AI ambition to business impact
author: Rodrigo Kede Lima

blocks.text: Most business leaders I meet no longer need to be convinced that AI works. They’ve seen the pilots, the demos and the copilots. The question I hear in boardrooms now is different: How do we move from AI that impresses to AI that changes how the business actually runs?
blocks.zh: 我见到的大多数商业领袖 不再需要相信AI有用了他们看到飞行员,演示和副驾驶。我现在在会议室听到的问题是不同的:我们如何从印象深刻的AI转向改变业务实际运行方式的AI?.
blocks.en: Most business leaders I meet no longer need to be convinced that AI works. They’ve seen the pilots, the demos and the copilots. The question I hear in boardrooms now is different: How do we move from AI that impresses to AI that changes how the business actually runs?

blocks.text: That is the question Microsoft Frontier Company was built to answer, and to date, we have engaged on nearly 500 projects with over 200 customers across 28 countries.
blocks.zh: 这就是微软前沿公司为了回答的问题,至今,我们与28个国家的200多个客户进行了近500个项目。
blocks.en: That is the question Microsoft Frontier Company was built to answer, and to date, we have engaged on nearly 500 projects with over 200 customers across 28 countries.

blocks.text: Customers including 3M, Alaska Airlines, BMW, Core42, KT, Land O’Lakes, London Stock Exchange Group, Mastercard, McKesson, Northern Trust, Novo Nordisk, Publicis Groupe, Saint-Gobain, Siemens and Unilever are seeing real value from working side by side with our Forward Deployed Engineering teams.
blocks.zh: 包括3M在内的客户,阿拉斯加航空公司,宝马核心42号,KT, (韩语).欧莱克岛,伦敦证券交易所集团大师卡,麦克森北方信托,新诺迪丝克,公众集团,圣高宾,西门子和联合利华看到与我们前方部署的工程队并肩工作的真正价值。
blocks.en: Customers including 3M, Alaska Airlines, BMW, Core42, KT, Land O’Lakes, London Stock Exchange Group, Mastercard, McKesson, Northern Trust, Novo Nordisk, Publicis Groupe, Saint-Gobain, Siemens and Unilever are seeing real value from working side by side with our Forward Deployed Engineering teams.

blocks.text: More importantly, most customers where we have completed initial projects have returned for additional engagements, generating hundreds of follow-on projects. Customers don’t come back for engineers. They come back because the first engagement delivered something they could measure and they can see the next workflow worth redesigning.
blocks.zh: 更重要的是,我们已完成初步项目的多数客户已返回,要求增加聘用费,产生数百个后续项目。顾客不会回来找工程师。他们回来是因为第一次接触提供了可以衡量的东西,他们可以看到下一个工作流程值得重新设计。
blocks.en: More importantly, most customers where we have completed initial projects have returned for additional engagements, generating hundreds of follow-on projects. Customers don’t come back for engineers. They come back because the first engagement delivered something they could measure and they can see the next workflow worth redesigning.

blocks.text: The technology is ready. What slows AI down is everything around it. That means identifying where AI can deliver the greatest value, building in trust and governance, redesigning the operating models and helping people work in new ways. Technology and people have to move forward together.
blocks.zh: 技术已经准备好了。使AI减慢的是周围的一切.这意味着要确定AI能提供最大价值的地方,建立信任和治理,重新设计运行模式并用新方式帮助人们工作.科技与人民必须共同前进.
blocks.en: The technology is ready. What slows AI down is everything around it. That means identifying where AI can deliver the greatest value, building in trust and governance, redesigning the operating models and helping people work in new ways. Technology and people have to move forward together.

blocks.text: What this looks like in practice
blocks.zh: 这在实际上是什么样子的
blocks.en: What this looks like in practice

blocks.text: Unilever is collaborating with Microsoft engineers to bring AI into its factories. On the factory floor, intelligent technology helps teams boost efficiency and deliver superior products to customers. In Pondicherry factory — Unilever’s largest Home Care Liquids factory in South Asia and a 2026 World Economic Forum Lighthouse site — a digital twin built on NVIDIA Omniverse and hosted on Azure simulates a real factory environment with integrated live data. This helps anticipate issues before they occur, monitors performance in real time and guides operators through the fixes and recommendations.
blocks.zh: 联合利华正与微软工程师合作将AI带入其工厂.在工厂地板上智能技术帮助团队提高效率,并向客户提供上等产品.在Pondicherry工厂——联合利华最大的南亚家庭护理液体工厂和一个2026年世界经济论坛灯塔站点——一个以NVIDIA Omniverse和NVIDIA Omniverse为基础的数字双子厂。在Azure上主机模拟了一个真实的工厂环境,并配有综合的活数据.这有助于预测问题发生前,实时监测业绩,并通过修正和建议指导操作人员。
blocks.en: Unilever is collaborating with Microsoft engineers to bring AI into its factories. On the factory floor, intelligent technology helps teams boost efficiency and deliver superior products to customers. In Pondicherry factory — Unilever’s largest Home Care Liquids factory in South Asia and a 2026 World Economic Forum Lighthouse site — a digital twin built on NVIDIA Omniverse and hosted on Azure simulates a real factory environment with integrated live data. This helps anticipate issues before they occur, monitors performance in real time and guides operators through the fixes and recommendations.

blocks.text: 3M is working with our engineers to help its Global Business Services team automate customer order management. The companies are building an AI agent-driven workflow to assist with credit checks, delinquency assessments and system updates, with human-in-the-loop controls and a custom monitoring dashboard for real-time visibility and approvals. The solution is expected to significantly reduce manual effort, improve speed and consistency and accelerate cash flow — freeing staff for higher-value work while enabling scalable, auditable operations.
blocks.zh: 3M公司正与我们的工程师合作,帮助其全球业务服务团队实现客户订单管理自动化.公司正在构建AI代理驱动的工作流程,以协助信用检查,犯罪评估和系统更新,配备人行控制装置和定制监测仪表板,用于实时可见度和核准。预计这一解决方案将大大减少人工努力,* 提高速度和一致性并加快现金流动——使工作人员能够从事价值较高的工作,同时能够扩大规模,可审计业务。
blocks.en: 3M is working with our engineers to help its Global Business Services team automate customer order management. The companies are building an AI agent-driven workflow to assist with credit checks, delinquency assessments and system updates, with human-in-the-loop controls and a custom monitoring dashboard for real-time visibility and approvals. The solution is expected to significantly reduce manual effort, improve speed and consistency and accelerate cash flow — freeing staff for higher-value work while enabling scalable, auditable operations.

blocks.text: Publicis Groupe is co-building with our engineers to bring AI into the heart of how it works and delivers for clients. Microsoft engineers work side by side with Publicis teams to design and build agentic processes grounded in Microsoft IQ, so agents work with the business context, data and knowledge behind Publicis’ work. These processes use reinforcement learning, drawing on real-world outcomes and human feedback to keep improving how the agents perform over time. The approach combines very fast engineering with hands-on knowledge transfer, helping Publicis build lasting AI capability. The work builds on Publicis’ rollout of Microsoft 365 Copilot to all 114,000 of its employees.
blocks.zh: Publicis Groupe正与我们的工程师共同建设,将AI带入它如何运作和交付给客户的核心.微软工程师与Publicis团队并肩工作,设计和构建以微软智商为基础的代理流程,所以,代理工作 与商业背景,公众工作背后的数据和知识。这些过程使用强化学习,利用现实世界的成果和人类的反馈,不断改进代理人在一段时间内的表现。这种方法结合了非常快的工程学和实用的知识转让,帮助Publicis建立持久的AI能力.这项工作是在Publicis推出微软365型Copilot系统的基础上向所有114 000名雇员推广的。
blocks.en: Publicis Groupe is co-building with our engineers to bring AI into the heart of how it works and delivers for clients. Microsoft engineers work side by side with Publicis teams to design and build agentic processes grounded in Microsoft IQ, so agents work with the business context, data and knowledge behind Publicis’ work. These processes use reinforcement learning, drawing on real-world outcomes and human feedback to keep improving how the agents perform over time. The approach combines very fast engineering with hands-on knowledge transfer, helping Publicis build lasting AI capability. The work builds on Publicis’ rollout of Microsoft 365 Copilot to all 114,000 of its employees.

blocks.text: Northern Trust needed to accelerate onboarding to its Asset Servicing Front Office Solutions platform, a process that took about two and a half weeks per client. Our engineers worked alongside Northern Trust’s experts to build an AI-powered onboarding agent within the Excel and SharePoint tools analysts already use. The result: data preparation time fell 83%, from two and a half weeks to three days, with 96.5% first-pass accuracy in testing. Analysts remain in control while gaining more time for higher-value client service.
blocks.zh: 北方信托公司需要加快进入其资产服务前沿办公室解决方案平台,一个过程,每个客户大约需要两周半的时间。我们的工程师与北方信托公司的专家合作,在已经使用的Excel和SharePoint工具分析器内建立了一个由AI驱动的登机代理。结果:数据编制时间下降83%,从两周半到三天,96.5%的首通测试精度。分析员仍然在控制之中,同时获得更多的时间提供价值较高的客户服务。
blocks.en: Northern Trust needed to accelerate onboarding to its Asset Servicing Front Office Solutions platform, a process that took about two and a half weeks per client. Our engineers worked alongside Northern Trust’s experts to build an AI-powered onboarding agent within the Excel and SharePoint tools analysts already use. The result: data preparation time fell 83%, from two and a half weeks to three days, with 96.5% first-pass accuracy in testing. Analysts remain in control while gaining more time for higher-value client service.

blocks.text: KT, one of South Korea’s largest telecommunications providers, wanted to help network operators identify and respond to problems faster. Our engineers worked from KT’s offices to co-build AIO-Net, a continuously learning AI agent platform informed by KT’s operating procedures and veteran network experts. It now detects network issues in two to three minutes, down from more than ten, while keeping people in control of decisions and actions.
blocks.zh: KT, (韩语).韩国最大的电信供应商之一想要帮助网络操作员更快地识别和应对问题.我们的工程师在KT的办公室工作 共同建造AIO-Net,不断学习AI代理平台,了解KT的操作程序和资深网络专家。它现在探测到网络问题 在两到三分钟内,下从十多来,同时也让人们控制着决定和行动。
blocks.en: KT, one of South Korea’s largest telecommunications providers, wanted to help network operators identify and respond to problems faster. Our engineers worked from KT’s offices to co-build AIO-Net, a continuously learning AI agent platform informed by KT’s operating procedures and veteran network experts. It now detects network issues in two to three minutes, down from more than ten, while keeping people in control of decisions and actions.

blocks.text: Saint-Gobain, the 360-year-old construction materials company, is using AI to help reduce the carbon footprint of cement. Working alongside its researchers, Microsoft engineers used Microsoft Discovery to gather 62,000 patents and 44,000 research abstracts into a knowledge base in hours, work Saint-Gobain estimates would have taken researchers a year. In about six weeks, the team identified new hypotheses for cement additives that scientists are now testing in the lab.
blocks.zh: 圣高宾,360年的建材公司,正在利用AI帮助减少水泥的碳足迹。与研究人员一起工作,微软工程师利用微软发现公司在数小时内收集了62 000项专利和44 000份研究摘要,将其输入一个知识库,Saint-Gobain的估算数字需要研究人员一年的时间。大约六周后该团队确定了新的关于水泥添加剂的假设,科学家们目前正在实验室中进行测试。
blocks.en: Saint-Gobain, the 360-year-old construction materials company, is using AI to help reduce the carbon footprint of cement. Working alongside its researchers, Microsoft engineers used Microsoft Discovery to gather 62,000 patents and 44,000 research abstracts into a knowledge base in hours, work Saint-Gobain estimates would have taken researchers a year. In about six weeks, the team identified new hypotheses for cement additives that scientists are now testing in the lab.

blocks.text: Across all of these customers, the pattern is the same:
blocks.zh: 在所有这些客户中,模式相同:
blocks.en: Across all of these customers, the pattern is the same:

blocks.text: Begin with the value, not the technology.
blocks.zh: 从价值开始而不是技术。
blocks.en: Begin with the value, not the technology.

blocks.text: Redesign the process, not just the task.
blocks.zh: 重新设计程序,不只是任务
blocks.en: Redesign the process, not just the task.

blocks.text: Build in fast cycles with the customer’s teams.
blocks.zh: 与客户团队建立快速循环。
blocks.en: Build in fast cycles with the customer’s teams.

blocks.text: Put security, governance and cost management in place from day one, so scaling doesn’t stall.
blocks.zh: 设置安全,从第一天起就实施治理和成本管理,因此缩放不会拖延时间。
blocks.en: Put security, governance and cost management in place from day one, so scaling doesn’t stall.

blocks.text: This is how organizations move from isolated AI projects to sustainable transformation: by focusing on measurable outcomes, redesigning work and building the capabilities to keep improving over time.
blocks.zh: 这就是各组织如何从孤立的AI项目转向可持续的转型:通过注重可衡量的成果,重新设计工作并建设随着时间的推移不断改进的能力。
blocks.en: This is how organizations move from isolated AI projects to sustainable transformation: by focusing on measurable outcomes, redesigning work and building the capabilities to keep improving over time.

blocks.text: New research from IDC underscores why this approach matters. While 66% of organizations report substantial or transformative results from AI, only 48% are scaling or seeing consistent value across their organizations. At the same time, 71% expect AI spending to increase by at least 10% in the next year, putting even greater pressure on businesses to demonstrate measurable returns. The challenge is no longer simply adopting AI. It is reimagining how work gets done and turning that transformation into lasting business impact.
blocks.zh: 国际数据中心的新研究突出表明了这一方法为何重要。66%的组织报告AI取得了实质性或变革性成果,只有48%的组织在扩大规模或看到一致的价值。同时,71%预计明年人工智能支出将至少增加10%,给企业带来更大的压力,以显示可衡量的回报。挑战不再仅仅是通过大赦国际。它正在重新设想如何开展工作,并将这种转变转化为持久的商业影响。
blocks.en: New research from IDC underscores why this approach matters. While 66% of organizations report substantial or transformative results from AI, only 48% are scaling or seeing consistent value across their organizations. At the same time, 71% expect AI spending to increase by at least 10% in the next year, putting even greater pressure on businesses to demonstrate measurable returns. The challenge is no longer simply adopting AI. It is reimagining how work gets done and turning that transformation into lasting business impact.

blocks.text: We’re holding ourselves to the same standard
blocks.zh: 我们坚持同样的标准
blocks.en: We’re holding ourselves to the same standard

blocks.text: If we’re asking customers to redesign how they work around AI, we have to do the same. Microsoft Frontier Company was deliberately designed to be flat and fast, with one front door for customers, and as a reference for what an AI-native organization can look like. We are learning, adjusting and moving fast, the same way we ask our customers to.
blocks.zh: 如果我们要求顾客重新设计他们如何在AI周围工作,我们必须做同样的事情。微软前沿公司被刻意设计为平坦快活,一扇门给顾客,并且作为AI-native组织的外形的参考.我们正在学习,调整和移动迅速,和我们要求客户做的一样
blocks.en: If we’re asking customers to redesign how they work around AI, we have to do the same. Microsoft Frontier Company was deliberately designed to be flat and fast, with one front door for customers, and as a reference for what an AI-native organization can look like. We are learning, adjusting and moving fast, the same way we ask our customers to.

blocks.text: The real measure of success
blocks.zh: 衡量成功的真正尺度
blocks.en: The real measure of success

blocks.text: The gap between AI that impresses and AI that delivers won’t close on its own. It closes workflow by workflow, with people who understand the business sitting next to people who can build.
blocks.zh: 给人印象深刻的AI与提供AI之间的差距不会靠自己来弥补.它通过工作流程关闭工作流程,与那些理解生意的人坐在那些能够建设的人旁边。
blocks.en: The gap between AI that impresses and AI that delivers won’t close on its own. It closes workflow by workflow, with people who understand the business sitting next to people who can build.

blocks.text: Our success will be measured by more than what we deliver. The real test is what our customers can do after we’ve worked together: run, govern and improve their own AI systems, on their terms, with their intelligence protected. Their success is the clearest measure of ours.
blocks.zh: 我们的成功将更多地以我们的成果来衡量。真正的考验是我们客户合作后能做些什么:运行,管理和改进自己的人工智能系统;根据他们的条件,他们的智慧受到保护。他们的成功是我们最明确的衡量标准。
blocks.en: Our success will be measured by more than what we deliver. The real test is what our customers can do after we’ve worked together: run, govern and improve their own AI systems, on their terms, with their intelligence protected. Their success is the clearest measure of ours.

blocks.text: Learn more at www.microsoft.com/en-us/frontier-company.
blocks.zh: 在www.microsoft.com/en-us/frontier-company上学习更多内容。
blocks.en: Learn more at www.microsoft.com/en-us/frontier-company.

blocks.text: Rodrigo Kede Lima is the President of Microsoft Frontier Company and leads the operating business of 6,000 industry and engineering experts focused on delivering Frontier Transformation through AI for customers around the world.
blocks.zh: 罗德里戈·克德·利马出任微软前沿公司总裁并领导了6号的运营业务.1000名工业和工程专家专注于通过AI为世界各地的客户提供"前沿转型".
blocks.en: Rodrigo Kede Lima is the President of Microsoft Frontier Company and leads the operating business of 6,000 industry and engineering experts focused on delivering Frontier Transformation through AI for customers around the world.
